items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think she’s just buried in Billy Harper’s group... Very good player, but I don’t know what’s the reason I’m not hearing more about her.

ctx.x: I think she’s just buried in Billy Harper’s group. She’s a very strong, feisty piano player, but you’d never know that. She’s very quiet and shy. I’m really trying to push her into doing a solo thing, so that people can hear her, because I’ve heard her on records with the band, and I’m sure she’s wonderful with them, but I don’t think she’s advancing her own career as well as she should. There’s some players out there. I don’t know what happens with this woman. Stacey Rowles. Very good player, but I don’t know…
young, black, very pretty, great talent. She just went out and made herself a rock record. Not really rock. That stuff they play on smooth jazz.
